brief:
Palestinians conducted 23 resistance operations across the West Bank during a 48-hour period, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included an attempted ramming attack alongside other forms of resistance activity.

The report did not specify the exact locations or breakdown of the different types of operations carried out during the timeframe. Palestinian resistance groups have regularly reported such activities in the West Bank, where Israeli military operations and settlement expansion continue.
